local fruits = {"apple", "banana", "cherry"}
for i, fruit in ipairs(fruits) do
  print(i .. ": " .. fruit)
end

local score = 85
if score >= 90 then
  print('Grade A')
elseif score >= 80 then
  print('Grade B')
else
  print('Grade C')
end

person.city = "New York"
for key, value in pairs(person) do
  print(key .. ": " .. value)
end
